title: Lawlessness
summary: LAW'LESSNESS, noun The quality or state of being unrestrained by law; disorder. LAW'-MAKER, noun One who enacts or ordains laws; a legislator; a lawgiver. Law-makers should not be law-breakers. LAW'-M
